notes:
Hosting should be steadier, and your login no longer ends up in log files.

The game server could read memory it had already freed every time it looked something up, and at the end of a match it could act on a network component that was being taken apart. Fixes for both, and for several smaller unchecked writes, were made in July but never reached the version you were running. They are in now.

The intro video no longer tries to play inside the hidden server that runs while you host. That server has no screen, so all it did was fill the log with errors.

The launcher's startup log used to record your login token on every launch. It now writes it as "eg1~<redacted>".

This release also includes the loading-screen fix from 1.9.2.

These changes have been built and tested, but not yet played through a full match. If a match misbehaves, send the log from the Logs tab.
